content.text: Hand-built JQL-like filter strings in application code are a common source of escaping bugs and typos on field names.

Ship SDK helpers such as filters.and(filters.eq('status', 'Done'), filters.contains('labels', 'backend')) that produce the wire filter AST the search API already accepts, with TypeScript/Python typed field name unions generated from field metadata.
Acceptance: helpers cover eq, neq, in, contains, gt/lt on dates; output matches hand-written filters in golden tests; no runtime dependency on a full JQL parser.
